notes.title: 🧊 FEAR BELOW ZERO - Survival Horror Comes to Antarctica 🧊
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Waffle Cone Willie survivors![/p][p]Thanks to all of you, my little evil ice cream mascot game somehow became a viral sensation that millions of people watched streamers get absolutely wrecked by. Honestly, I'm still processing that this actually happened.[/p][p]But here's the thing - apparently success made me think "you know what the world needs? MORE reasons to be terrified!" So I've been working on something new...[/p][p][b]Fear Below Zero[/b] is my next survival horror game, and this time instead of a deranged mascot, you're being hunted by a 90-million-year-old prehistoric creature in Antarctica. Think Alien: Isolation but everyone needs thermal underwear and the alien is technically your distant evolutionary cousin.[/p][p]Key features include:[/p][p]🧊 No combat (because I apparently hate giving players any sense of power)
🧊 Constant hypothermia management
🧊 A monster that stalks you, think Alien: Isolation and Amnesia: The Bunker
🧊 More resource scrapping than a post-apocalyptic survival show[/p][p]
[b]Wishlist on Steam:[/b][url="https://cutt.ly/fear-below-zero"] [/url][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3847850/Fear_Below_Zero/"][/dynamiclink]Your support on Waffle Cone Willie is literally the only reason I get to keep making weird horror games, so if this looks like your kind of nightmare fuel, hitting that wishlist button would mean everything to me.[/p][p]December 2025 release - because nothing says "happy holidays" like prehistoric terror in a frozen wasteland.[/p][p]Thanks for being the best community a solo dev could ask for![/p][p]-Corsgames[/p][p]P.S. Yes, there will be streamers getting their souls ejected from their bodies again. Some things never change.[/p]

notes.title: Waffle Cone Willie is HERE!
notes.notes:
The wait is finally over! I'm thrilled (and slightly terrified) to announce that Waffle Cone Willie is officially live on Steam. 🎉

Step into the eerie town of Sweetwater, where daylight is gone, and a sinister force hunts in the night. You’ll have to explore, solve puzzles, and outwit a possessed ice cream truck to uncover the fate of the missing children—before Willie gets to you.

Are you ready for the chase? Or will you fall victim to Willie’s relentless pursuit?

[list]
[*] 🕹️ Play Now: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3088180/Waffle_Cone_Willie/]Get Waffle Cone Willie on Steam[/url]
[*] 🔍 Explore abandoned houses, solve cryptic puzzles, and dive into Sweetwater’s chilling mystery.
[*] 🚚 Don’t forget—once the truck is on the move, there's no place to hide.
[*] 📹 Share your gameplay clips and experiences using #WaffleConeWillie for a chance to be featured!
[/list]

Thank you for all your support on this journey. I can’t wait to hear your thoughts and watch you take on Willie!

Stay brave,
Corey @ Corsgames

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.5
notes.notes:
Demo patch 1.5. Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!

- Improved the physics of destructibles
- Further improvements on Willie's AI
- The player now starts with the flashlight and batteries are no longer needed!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
Demo patch 1.4. Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!

- Fixed a bug where Willie's movements and speed would bug out under higher and variable framerates
- Optimized game so fewer physics calls are run every frame
- Increased the volume and hearing range of destructibles

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
Demo patch 1.3. Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!

[list]
[*] Improved Willie’s AI
[*] Willie can now “vanish” obstacles temporarily, to reach the player
[*] Changed and optimized Willie’s teleport animation
[*] Improved performance and optimized level to improve frame rates in certain areas
[*] Updated UI to release version’s UI
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Demo patch 1.2. Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!

[list]
[*] Fixed issue with Japanese, Chinese, and Korean characters appearing blank or empty
[*] Fixed a bug where upon loading a game, completed objective triggers would trigger again, even if the player has already seen them
[*] Fixed footstep sounds sometimes not triggering the right sound in 35 Nicole
[*] Fixed master bedroom drawer in 48 Fairview not opening
[*] Fixed locked toolbox hint message from accidentally revealing the location of the key
[*] Added a visual cue to press Play after inserting a VHS tape
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
First demo patch. Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!

- Added option to load last save on death
- Fixed bug where placeholder saves were shown in load screen
- Improved shadow quality from the flashlight
- Increased volume of "puzzle incorrect" notification
- Fixed a bug where "Find safe code" would not be marked as completed

notes.title: Waffle Cone Willie demo now available!
notes.notes:
The wait is over! The demo for Waffle Cone Willie is available today. Dive into the eerie town of Sweetwater, where you can explore two haunting streets, uncover hidden secrets, and experience the terror of surviving Willie’s relentless pursuit. Will you make it through the night? Download the demo now and find out!

Your feedback is greatly appreciated! Found a bug? Have feedback? Got a suggestion? Email us at hey@corsgames.com

notes.title: Waffle Cone Willie Is Coming...
notes.notes:
Hey, horror fans and ice cream enthusiasts! We're thrilled (and slightly terrified) to unveil the first trailer for Waffle Cone Willie, the sweetest horror game you'll play this year! 🍦👻

In the quaint, sugary town of Sweetwater, an urban legend chills the air: Waffle Cone Willie, the ghostly ice cream man with a dark past, has returned! Your mission? Collect four special items, dodge Willie's frosty fury, and bring daylight back to Sweetwater.

Expect spine-tingling chases, eerie houses, and a twisted story that will make you scream for more. Don't forget to watch out for Willie—he's always lurking around the corner, ready to scoop up anyone who dares to linger!

Check out the trailer now and stay tuned for more updates. Get ready to scream and shiver in the best (and coldest) way possible! 🍦🎃

Watch the trailer, wishlist the game, and let us know what you think in the comments! Sweet dreams... or are they nightmares? 😱

See you in Sweetwater... if you dare!
